features.title: Learn more about Earthworm
features.description: Take Earthworm to the next level with these powerful features!

feedback.title: Real-time feedback and progress tracking
feedback.desc: Earthworm provides precise and instant feedback, helping learners immediately correct deviations. With efficient progress tracking, every learner can monitor their learning journey and clearly recognize their milestones

contextual.title: Contextual language learning
contextual.desc: Earthworm carefully designs rich contextual learning content, helping users deeply understand word usage in different contexts, effectively improving vocabulary accuracy and adaptability, making language learning closer to real application scenarios

expression.title: Improve language expression skills
expression.desc: Through systematic sentence construction exercises, this app not only strengthens learners' understanding of vocabulary usage and grammar structures, but also effectively improves oral and written expression fluency and accuracy, making language expression more natural and precise

vocabulary.title: Enhance vocabulary retention
vocabulary.desc: Earthworm adopts unique word-sentence construction methods, deepening learners' memory and application ability of vocabulary. Through practice reinforcing understanding, significantly improving long-term vocabulary retention

collocations.title: Master common collocations and idioms
collocations.desc: Earthworm integrates rich vocabulary collocations and idiomatic expression learning resources, helping learners accurately master natural language expression ways, making language use more authentic and fluent, enhancing communication naturalness and effectiveness

keyboard.title: Keyboard sound effects
keyboard.desc: For professional users pursuing ultimate learning experience, provides diverse keyboard sound settings and pronunciation method choices, aiming to optimize auditory feedback, enhance learning immersion and efficiency, making English learning more efficient and enjoyable

accept.title: 1. Accept Terms
accept.content1: Users must carefully read and agree to these terms before using this service. If users do not agree to these terms, they should not register or use this service.
accept.content2: These terms may be updated at any time. Updated terms become effective once published. Continued use of this service will be considered as acceptance of the updated terms.

account.title: 2. Account Registration and Use
account.content1: Users should provide true, accurate, complete personal information and keep information updated.
account.content2: Users are responsible for all activities under their account and should properly protect account information and passwords to prevent unauthorized use.

privacy.title: 3. Privacy Policy
privacy.content1: This service respects user privacy and promises not to disclose user personal information unless authorized by the user or required by law.
privacy.content2: This service may collect user information to provide personalized services. Please refer to the privacy policy for details.

intellectual.title: 4. Intellectual Property

intellectual.content2: Without permission, users may not copy, distribute, display or otherwise use content in this service.

behavior.title: 5. User Behavior Guidelines
behavior.content1: Users should comply with laws and regulations and may not use this service for illegal activities.
behavior.content2: Users may not upload, publish or distribute content that infringes on others' legitimate rights and interests.

limits.title: 6. Service Use Limits
limits.content1: This service may set usage limits, including but not limited to usage frequency, storage space, etc.
limits.content2: This service has the right to adjust usage limits as needed and notify users in advance.

liability.title: 7. Liability Limits and Disclaimer
liability.content1: This service is provided as-is and does not assume any losses caused by using this service.
liability.content2: This service does not guarantee service continuity, security, accuracy or timeliness.

legal.title: 8. Legal Application and Dispute Resolution
legal.content1: The interpretation, validity and execution of these terms are governed by the laws of the service provider's location.
legal.content2: In case of dispute, both parties should negotiate in good faith. If negotiation fails, either party may file a lawsuit with the people's court at the service provider's location.

termination.title: 9. Termination of Service Relationship
termination.content1: Users may terminate use of this service at any time. This service may also terminate or limit user use according to terms.
termination.content2: After termination, user's right to use this service terminates immediately.

collection.title: 1. Personal Information Collection
collection.content1: When users register, we will collect user personal information, including but not limited to name, email address, phone number, etc.
collection.content2: We collect this information to verify user identity, provide services, and communicate with users.

use.title: 2. Personal Information Use
use.content1: We will use collected personal information to provide user registration services and improve our services.
use.content2: We will not sell personal information to third parties unless explicitly consented by the user.

storage.title: 3. Personal Information Storage
storage.content1: We will take reasonable security measures to protect user personal information, preventing unauthorized access, use or disclosure.
storage.content2: Personal information storage period will be determined according to laws and regulations and business needs.

share.title: 4. Personal Information Sharing
share.content1: We will not share user personal information with third parties unless explicitly consented by the user or required by law.
share.content2: We may share necessary information with service providers to provide and improve our services.

rights.title: 5. User Rights
rights.content1: Users have the right to access, correct or delete their personal information.
rights.content2: Users have the right to choose whether to receive marketing emails or other promotional information from us.

update.title: 6. Privacy Policy Updates
update.content1: We may update this privacy policy at any time to reflect service changes or comply with new laws and regulations.
update.content2: Updated privacy policy becomes effective once published.

cookie.title: 7. How the Product Uses Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies
cookie.content1: To ensure normal product operation, the product will store small data files called Cookies on your computer or mobile device. Cookies usually contain identifiers, product names, and some numbers and characters. With Cookies, the product can store your preferences or product data, and determine if registered users have logged in, improving service quality and user experience.
cookie.content2: The product uses various Cookies for different purposes, including: strictly necessary Cookies, performance Cookies, marketing Cookies, and functional Cookies. Some Cookies may be provided by external third parties to provide other functions to the product. The product will not use Cookies for purposes other than those described in this policy. You can manage or delete Cookies according to your preferences.
cookie.content3: You can clear all Cookies saved on your computer or phone. Most web browsers have functions to block or disable Cookies, which you can configure. After blocking or disabling Cookies, you may not be able to use or fully use the product's services.
